name: The Benandanti
summary: An agrarian spirit-guild who believed they were chosen at birth to battle malevolent sorcerers in the astral plane.
lore: The Benandanti were born with a caul (amniotic sac) over their heads—a sign they possessed innate spiritual powers. Four times a year, during the Ember Days, their souls were said to leave their sleeping bodies in the forms of small animals (cats, hares, or butterflies). They flew to distant spiritual battlefields to clash with the Malandanti (evil witches). The Benandanti fought with bundles of fennel, while the bad witches wielded sorghum brooms. If the Good Walkers won, the harvest was saved; if they lost, famine followed.

events.title: The Ember Days Battle
events.narrative: The Ember Days fall. Tonight your souls must leave your bodies and fly to the astral battlefield to clash with the Malandanti for the fate of the harvest.

choiceA.label: March out with fennel bundles
choiceA.description: +25% Faith if you win, −6 Followers if you lose

random.winMessage: The Malandanti break before your fennel. The harvest is saved, and word of the victory spreads. +25% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The Malandanti's sorghum brooms scatter your walkers. Six souls do not return. −6 Followers.

choiceB.label: Send only the elders and guard the young

events.title: The Malandanti Raid the Granaries
events.narrative: In the night, the Malandanti stole into the granaries of Udine and carried off the seed grain. The villagers wake to empty stores and frightened whispers.

choiceB.label: Replenish the grain from your own stores

events.title: The Udine Night-Walkers Challenge You
events.narrative: The Night-Walkers of Udine claim the Ember battlefield is theirs by right of birth. They demand your walkers stand down or face them in the astral square.

choiceA.label: Accept the challenge and fly out tonight
choiceA.description: +25% Faith if you win, −5 Followers if you lose

random.winMessage: You outflank the Udine walkers in the astral dusk. They yield the field and three of their number join you. +25% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The Udine walkers are stronger than rumor said. Five of your own are lost in the astral dark. −5 Followers.

events.title: A Child Born with the Caul
events.narrative: A farmwife gives birth to a son with the caul still over his face — the sign of the Benandanti. The whole village takes it as an omen and looks to you.

choiceA.label: Claim the child for the order

events.title: The Fennel-Bearers of Gorizia
events.narrative: The borderland healers of Gorizia send word: Malandanti have been seen crossing the mountain passes with bundles of sorghum, heading for the lowland villages.

choiceB.label: Warn the lowland villages to hide their grain

events.title: The Caul-Born of Trieste
events.narrative: The sea-witches of Trieste claim a storm is coming that only the caul-born can read. They offer to share the omen — for a price.

choiceA.label: Pay them and hear the omen

choiceB.label: Read the storm yourself
choiceB.description: +22% Faith if right, −4 Followers if wrong

random.winMessage: Your reading proves true. The fleet is saved, and the caul-born of Trieste concede your power. +22% Faith.
random.lossMessage: You misread the storm. Four boats are lost, and four families leave your order. −4 Followers.

events.title: The Inquisitor from Rome
events.narrative: A Church inquisitor arrives in Friuli, asking about 'those born with the caul who fly at night.' He is gentle in manner but relentless in questioning.

choiceA.label: Deny everything and hide the caul-children

choiceB.label: Convince him you are a force for good
choiceB.description: +20% Faith if he believes, −5 Followers if not

random.winMessage: You speak of battling witches for the harvest. The inquisitor writes that you are misguided but not evil, and leaves. +20% Faith.
random.lossMessage: He is not convinced. Five of your walkers are named in his report and must flee. −5 Followers.

events.title: The Hare That Would Not Change Back
events.narrative: One of your walkers flew out as a hare and has not returned to his body by dawn. His wife weeps at his bedside; his breath stills.

choiceA.label: Fly out to find his wandering soul

choiceB.label: Declare him a martyr of the order

events.title: A Friulian Noble's Patronage
events.narrative: A noblewoman from the foothills arrives with a heavy chest. 'My harvests have failed three years running. The priests cannot help me. Perhaps you can.'

choiceA.label: Accept her donation and bless her fields

events.title: The Famine Omen
events.narrative: The walkers return from the Ember battle pale and shaken. They say the Malandanti won this round, and the grain will fail before autumn.

choiceA.label: Ration the stores and preach endurance
